richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Muzaffarpur

c: Muzaffarpur is famous for its litchis, and the orchards around the city ripen just as the summer heat peaks. FunPlay Systems is an outdoor gym equipment supplier in Muzaffarpur for schools, colleges, hospitals, residential colonies and the municipal corporation's parks. We manufacture every machine at our factory in Vasai, about 1480 km away, and send it to north Bihar by road.

Our installation team or a dealer in eastern India fixes the machines on site. Muzaffarpur sits in a flat river plain with a long monsoon and frequent waterlogging. Summers are hot and humid, and winters bring cold, foggy mornings. Galvanised frames resist rust in this climate, but drainage needs the most planning. A raised concrete base under each machine keeps the footings clear of standing water.

items.q: Can a hospital in Muzaffarpur set up an outdoor gym for staff and visitors?
items.a: Yes. A few gentle machines along a garden path work well. Share the site plan and the expected users, and we will suggest stations and a layout for approval.

items.q: What base works best on waterlogged ground?
items.a: A raised concrete base with a slight slope. After heavy rain, clear standing water and silt from the footings and check that each machine is still firm.

items.q: How do I get spare parts after the warranty?
items.a: Contact our after-sales team on +91 738 530 0921 or aftersales@funplaysystems.com with the machine name and a photo. They will arrange the part for you.
